But some doubted

Richard Crashaw (W.) (c. 1613–1649)

M
ATT.
 
XXVIII.
 17
.
E
ARTH,
 quaking, wavers: if that fact be true,
The wavering earth forbids you waver too.
The very keepers, if their voice, you seek,
Though speechless, even by their silence speak.
